name: Salzkotten (Germany)
description: White hoist charged with the city arms of Salzkotten (a yellow trefoil on red), the fly divided horizontally red over yellow.
history: Hoisted flag and banner are described as red and yellow striped with the city shield in the white flag or banner head; the present seal and flag were approved by deed of the Regierungspräsident in Detmold of 9 December 1976, the arms having been approved in their present colours by the Prussian king in 1908.

features.role: white flag head at the hoist, the fly divided red over yellow
